"""RoboPaint eai-standard/2.2 trajectory builder for the exemplar 然.
This file keeps the geometric mapping and stroke plan used during the episode.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

DT = 0.05
DOWN = np.array([0., 1., 0., 0.])  # brush axis points down
MM = 0.227185
PIXEL = MM / 1024


def lerp_rows(start, end, max_step=0.008):
    start, end = np.asarray(start, float), np.asarray(end, float)
    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(end[:3] - start[:3]) / max_step)))
    return np.linspace(start, end, n + 1)[1:]


def pose(x, y, z, q=DOWN):
    return np.r_[x, y, z, q]


def pixel_to_world(u, v, z=0.02):
    """Target raster centers to world XYZ; row 0 is the far (+x) edge."""
    X = (u + 0.5) * PIXEL
    Y = (v + 0.5) * PIXEL
    # Main sheet center is x=-0.1, y=0; its far/left corner is x=0.0135925,y=+0.1135925.
    return np.array([0.0135925 - Y, 0.1135925 - X, z])


def execute_pose_rows(r, poses, note=""):
    rows=[]; last=poses[0]
    for nxt in poses[1:]:
        rows.extend(lerp_rows(last, nxt))
        last=nxt
    if not rows:
        return None
    return r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(rows), dt=DT, video="mp4", note=note)


def move(r, current, target, max_step=0.008, note="move"):
    rows=lerp_rows(current, target, max_step=max_step)
    res=r.submit("ee_pose", rows, dt=DT, video="mp4", note=note)
    return np.asarray(rows[-1]), res


if __name__ == "__main__":
    r=Robot(); print("status",r.status())
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=["canvas_cam","practice_cam","scene_cam","side_cam"],video="none")
    p=np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14],float)
    up=p.copy(); up[2]=0.25
    p,res=move(r,p,up,note="raise from initial pose")
    practice_hover=pose(-0.1,-0.1856,0.25)
    p,res=move(r,p,practice_hover,note="clear main sheet to practice hover")
    res.save("/app/runs/001_hover")
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=["canvas_cam","practice_cam","scene_cam","side_cam"],depth=True,video="none")
    from PIL import Image
    for c,im in obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(f"/app/output/hover_{c}.png")
    print("status",r.status())
    print("tip",obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14])

"""RoboPaint eai-standard/2.2 trajectory for copying 楷书 然.

Calibrated on the practice sheet: a 12 mm tip height makes an ~9 mm line;
9-11 mm produces the broader ~14-17 mm line. Paper surface is z=20 mm.
Target paths use target.png pixel-center coordinates and the declared sheet frame.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

DT = 0.05
DOWN = np.array([0., 1., 0., 0.])   # tip quaternion at start; brush points down
SHEET_M = 0.227185
PX_M = SHEET_M / 1024
PAPER_Z = 0.020
INK_XY = (-0.100, 0.150)
INK_Z = 0.014
HOVER_Z = 0.105


def pose(x, y, z, q=DOWN):
    return np.r_[float(x), float(y), float(z), np.asarray(q, float)]


def pixel_to_world(u, v, z=PAPER_Z):
    """Map target pixel-center coordinates into the main-sheet world frame."""
    X = (float(u) + 0.5) * PX_M       # from image left (+y) toward image right (-y)
    Y = (float(v) + 0.5) * PX_M       # from image top (+x) toward image bottom (-x)
    return np.array([0.0135925 - Y, 0.1135925 - X, float(z)])


def append_segment(rows, a, b, max_step):
    a=np.asarray(a,float); b=np.asarray(b,float)
    n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b[:3]-a[:3])/max_step)))
    rows.extend(np.linspace(a,b,n+1)[1:])
    return b


def make_rows(start, waypoints, max_step=0.006, hold_end=0.0):
    rows=[]; cur=np.asarray(start,float)
    for p,step in waypoints:
        cur=append_segment(rows,cur,p,step if step is not None else max_step)
    if hold_end:
        rows.extend([cur.copy() for _ in range(int(round(hold_end/DT)))])
    return np.asarray(rows,float),cur


def run_rows(r, rows, note, out=None):
    if not len(rows): return None
    res=r.submit('ee_pose', rows, dt=DT, cameras=['canvas_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],
                 video='none', note=note)
    if out: res.save(out)
    print(note, 'rows',len(rows),'plan',res.meta.get('plan'),'status',r.status())
    return res


def measured_pose(r):
    return np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none').meta['proprio']['now'][7:14],float)


def dip_and_withdraw(r, start, name):
    wh=pose(*INK_XY,0.12); dip=pose(*INK_XY,INK_Z)
    seq=[(wh,0.006),(dip,0.003),(dip,0.003),(wh,0.003),(wh,0.003)]
    rows,end=make_rows(start,seq,hold_end=0.40)
    run_rows(r,rows,f'{name}: dip and reset brush',f'/app/runs/{name}_dip')
    return end


def draw_stroke(r, current, name, points, contact_z, inspect=False):
    pts=[pixel_to_world(u,v,contact_z) for u,v in points]
    start=pts[0]; end=pts[-1]
    seq=[(pose(start[0],start[1],HOVER_Z),0.006),
         (start,0.003)]
    seq.extend((p,0.0025) for p in pts[1:])
    seq.extend([(pose(end[0],end[1],HOVER_Z),0.003),
                (pose(end[0],end[1],HOVER_Z),0.003)])
    rows,final=make_rows(current,seq,hold_end=0.30)
    run_rows(r,rows,f'{name}: main-sheet stroke',f'/app/runs/{name}')
    if inspect:
        # Move clear of the scored sheet so the next camera frame is unobstructed.
        clear=pose(*INK_XY,0.25)
        clear_rows,final=make_rows(final,[(clear,0.006)],hold_end=0.50)
        run_rows(r,clear_rows,f'{name}: clear for alignment inspection',f'/app/runs/{name}_clear')
        obs=r.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],video='none')
        from PIL import Image
        for cam,img in obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(img).save(f'/app/output/{name}_{cam}.png')

    return final

def dip_and_withdraw(r, start, name):
    wh=pose(*INK_XY,0.12); dip=pose(*INK_XY,INK_Z)

def compensated_path(points, start_advance=28.0, end_advance=8.0):
    """Trim the first end and extend the last to offset the brush's 6-7 mm entry drag."""
    p=np.asarray(points,float)
    seg=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p,axis=0),axis=1)
    cum=np.r_[0.,np.cumsum(seg)]; total=float(cum[-1])
    if total < 2.0: return p.tolist()
    a=min(start_advance,total*0.60)
    def at(s):
        if s<=0:return p[0].copy()
        if s>=total:return p[-1].copy()
        j=int(np.searchsorted(cum,s,side='right')-1)
        f=(s-cum[j])/max(seg[j],1e-9)
        return p[j]*(1-f)+p[j+1]*f
    out=[at(a)]
    out.extend(p[j].copy() for j in range(1,len(p)-1) if cum[j]>a)
    v=p[-1]-p[-2]; v=v/max(np.linalg.norm(v),1e-9)
    out.append(p[-1]+end_advance*v)
    return out
